problem: Problem 4: With and without cached tokens

setups.no_cache: Random request id at the start of the instructions on every call, so no two calls share a prefix; explicit cache mode with no breakpoints. Nothing can be read from the cache.
setups.cache: Identical instructions (prompt.md + handbook) on every call, stable prompt_cache_key, and a cache breakpoint after the instructions, so the handbook is reused from the cache.

portkey_response_cache: bypassed on every call (x-portkey-cache-force-refresh), so each call is a real model call; all_response_ids_unique confirms no replays
